task.title: P6-035: [parked] Set picker offers sets with no ingested printings
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Parked — real, deliberately deferred; do not work until its trigger fires). Original id: P6-035. Specs: specs/catalog-ingestion.md, specs/catalog-search.md.

**The set picker offers sets with no ingested printings** — `hosted.rs:327-366`'s `list_sets` has no join to `printings`, and the dev catalog has 1045 sets against ~2976 printings, so most picks return zero results.

**Trigger: `P6-108` lands, then re-triage** — near-moot with a full ingest; a "has cards" filter would be a join.
